sideboard_plans.source_context: S2's first-person Prowess plan adds Torpor Orb, Surrak, and Pawpatch, and trims a Harmonizer, two Hydra, and two Badgermole Cub from a different 75. This Worlds list lacks Pawpatch/Cub. Current Izzet Prowess creatures do not present an obvious Torpor Orb target: Pompous Battlemage enters prepared via a replacement effect, and Ravenous Cosmozoan has a cost-reduction ability.
